questions.KT-06: What documents do I need for an athletic scholarship?
questions.KT-05: What documents do international students need for their scholarship?
questions.KT-06b: Do athletic scholarship applicants need an NCAA eligibility certificate?

KT-05.1:
International students applying for the International Student Scholarship must provide a valid passport, proof of English proficiency (IELTS 6.5 or higher), and a financial statement showing how remaining costs will be covered.

Source: [International Student Scholarship – Required Documents](/lightning/r/Knowledge__kav/ka0jV000000nIDbQAM/view) (Article 000001001)
